scope: Actual CanonicalWebRtcAdapter, staged RTC controllers, Core routes and owned RTC IO through local ICE/DTLS/SRTP/SRTCP. Synthetic identities, current policy/readers and capture fixtures; no Store/signed WSS host, physical camera or installed browser qualification.
implementation: Canonical protected peers use the reviewed video repair/clock profile without exposing a public opt-in config. Ordinary peer constructors retain their previous profile. Per-kind source observation and bounded video reorder/normalization feed exact actual audio/video Core ports; no-RTP peers cannot become source ready.

Readiness requires original live ingress workers and actual matching media. Independent audio/video cancellation and failed-worker invalidation retain original peer/port/controller custody until joined cleanup. Desired programs validate one logical stream per medium without rejecting stale failed preparations.

One bounded VP8/90000 primary mapping and optional exact RTX apt are negotiated from actual matching offer/answer m-sections. Ambiguous payloads, MID extension collisions, unsupported VP8 fmtp, RID/simulcast including dangling raw declarations and non-FID video groups refuse. Peer-bound CoreVideoEgress carries the same negotiated MID on original and repaired RTP.

Audio writers receive the exact peer sender-clock handle when created. Core audio and video preserve original clock provenance and source-route liveness through owned IO. Missing required source timing cannot silently become native timing. This does not qualify actual RTCP SR timing or A/V synchronization.

Canonical ingress receives only original matching media, shares existing bounded VP8 reorder/repacketization and original 200ms age bounds, and fans out only to active exact per-kind ports. Video repair remains explicit, bounded and authorized at actual IO by opaque Core VideoRepair handles.

actual_picture_decode.generator: FFmpeg libvpx, one synthetic 64x64 solid-color keyframe per source; fixture sends one complete keyframe every 60ms alongside 20ms mono PCMU at negotiated dynamic PT109.
actual_picture_decode.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
actual_picture_decode.generation_command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i color=c={red|blue}:s=64x64:r=1 -frames:v 1 -c:v libvpx -deadline realtime -f ivf {color}.ivf; extract the first IVF frame payload to {color}.vp8
actual_picture_decode.decoder: ffmpeg -nostdin -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -f ivf -c:v vp8 -i received-{label}.ivf -frames:v 1 -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgb24 received-{label}.rgb
actual_picture_decode.limits: Distinct decoded static synthetic pictures, no motion, camera, playout, lip-sync or latency qualification.

failures_and_recovery: Initial upper build failed on an outdated audio-only initial_resources caller and a Simulcast enum pattern; generalized per-kind preparation and corrected the pattern, then rebuilt the entire affected five-library graph successfully.

An initial audio regression refused a valid retry because validation consulted old port preparations. Removed that restriction and retained per-program duplicate-kind validation; all seven staged audio and fourteen resource-lifetime groups pass.

Initial AV admitted four ports but delivered no decoded audio. The legacy audio writer had not received its peer clock outside stream conversion. Assigning the clock at physical track creation and preserving route-liveness provenance fixes actual guarded audio without dropping timing metadata.

An initial repair fixture NACKed an already delivered packet and timed out waiting for an application duplicate; duplicate suppression versus expiry was not independently determined. Replaced it with actual receiver-side primary loss and confirmed decrypted RTX/restored missing identity.
A negative profile test initially accepted dangling a=simulcast:send f because the shared parser omitted it. Raw original SDP checks now refuse it; all six profile tests pass.

A staging script partially edited a private source before a destination-exists assertion; no build or test success was claimed for that state. A fresh prepared snapshot and complete successful build precede final evidence.

The resource-lifetime test intentionally panics an actual ingress policy worker; subsequent invalidated-readiness and joined-cleanup assertions pass. The logged panic is the exercised failure fixture.
